thread:
Tara Nguyen: FYI - seeing a sustained burst in eu-west GPU requests, autoscaler can't keep up and nodes are piling into provisioning backlog. lots of jobs stuck Pending. :warning:
Omar Patel: Ugh. Is this spot churn or new capacity requests?
Tara Nguyen: Mostly new dedicated jobs from a customer test sweep + a few crazy reruns. spot churn is low, it's pure provisioning lag.
Liam Chen: Got logs from the cluster: kubelet is creating nodes but cloud provider API rate limiting -> node creation retries. sample: `error: quotaExceeded: rateLimitExceeded`
Marina Ortiz: @Omar any rate-limit buffers we can bump for the eu-west project?
Omar Patel: We've got conservative CPI quotas to avoid billing surprises. Could bump by 20% for 30m while we drain the backlog. need approval though.
Tara Nguyen: short term: can we re-route low-priority jobs to the NA pool until eu-west catches up? use nodeSelector + tolerations hack?
Liam Chen: We can add an admission webhook to tag those jobs, but faster: patch the scheduler to prefer region-agnostic jobs -> `kubectl patch` on the queue controller to set `regionAffinity: preferred: na` for class=best-effort.
Marina Ortiz: Also seeing fragmentation: the new small-instance nodes leave 2 GPUs unused due to strict pod GPU-requests. Might help to temporarily relax `gpu.bind-mode` to allow fractional packing.
Omar Patel: fractional packing risks noisy neighbors. But for <30m emergency it's OK. I'll open a ticket to revert after.
devops-bot: [alert] 2461230020 - eu-west node creation failures x37 in last 5m (rateLimitExceeded). Auto-retry scheduled in 60s.
Tara Nguyen: Proposed mitigation plan: 1) route low-priority to NA 2) bump CPI quota + temporary fractional packing 3) throttle new test sweeps (notify customer)
Liam Chen: +1. For (2) config snippet to apply:
```
# temporary scheduler tweak
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  gpu.packMode: "fractional-emergency"
  pack.duration: "30m"
```
Apply to eu-west nodepool controller.
Marina Ortiz: I'll message the customer to delay ramp by 1 hour. also enabling additional logging for node bootstrap so we can see if failures are rate vs image-pull.
Omar Patel: Bumped quota request submitted (change: +25%). added tag `emergency-euw-246123` so billing knows.
Tara Nguyen: Liam, can you run a one-off descheduler pass to collapse single-GPU leftovers into the new small nodes after nodes come up? should reduce fragmentation when things stabilize.
Liam Chen: Will do. running now in dry-run: `descheduler --policy-file=consolidate-leftovers.yaml --dry-run`
devops-bot: [info] 2461230205 - descheduler dry-run found 12 candidates for consolidation.
Marina Ortiz: Quick ask: track cost delta for the bump in a temp dashboard (per-minute). we need to report impact to finance.
Omar Patel: Adding cost delta metric to the eu-west dashboard; label `emergency-euw-246123`. ETA 10m.
Tara Nguyen: Thanks team. Follow-ups: confirm quota approved, confirm backlog drained, revert fractional packing after 30m, snapshot metrics for cost.
Liam Chen: Will post update when descheduler completes and when nodes become Ready.
Marina Ortiz: Update: customers agreed to pause for 45m.
Omar Patel: Quota approved by infra-ops at 2461230284. nodes are creating again.
Liam Chen: Descheduler run complete, consolidated 9 pods, freed 6 GPUs. backlog should clear in ~3min.
Tara Nguyen: Nice. I'll watch SLOs and reopen if anything flares. :thumbsup:
devops-bot: [resolved] 2461230300 - emergency mitigation complete, monitoring for 15m.
